name: Lollipop
summary: Big round swirl lollipop on a white stick, for sweets, party and candy scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the stick rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~330 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: color2
params.note: background colour of the candy disc and the stick

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
